newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-HOLDERS U.S. CRASH OUT OF FED CUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HOLDERS U.S. CRASH OUT OF FED CUP.

text.p: Holders the United States crashed out of the Fed Cup at the hands of the Netherlands on Sunday after they lost both reverse singles matches in their world group one tie.
The Dutch took an unbeatable 3-1 lead and will meet the Czech Republic in the semifinals.
Brenda Schultz-McCarthy and Miriam Oremans recorded victories over Mary Joe Fernandez and Chanda Rubin to eliminate the Americans, 15 times winners of the trophy.
The United States, led by new coach Martina Navratilova, appeared in control of Sunday's opening match as Fernandez breezed through the first set against Schultz-McCarthy.
The Dutch player started nervously, losing nine points in a row, while Fernandez dropped only three points in the first five games.
But Schultz-McCarthy fought back to take the match 1-6 6-4 9-7.
In-form Oremans, with victories over Germany's Anke Huber in Hanover last week and Mary Joe Fernandez on Saturday, sealed the tie with a 6-3 6-0 victory over Rubin.
